description: The explicit existential and universal tuple loops accept a table exactly when it satisfies the associated shared first-order sentence.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.accepts_correct (c : ℕ) (arities : List ℕ) {d m n : ℕ}
  (T : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.Table c arities d)
  (φ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.lang c arities).BoundedFormula Empty (m + n)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.accepts c arities T φ = true ↔
    Fin (d + 1) ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.sentence c arities φ
